Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Dharmendra Kumar Rajput

Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1.

Heard Sri Ajay Pandey, Advocate holding brief of Sri Dharmendra Kumar Rajput, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Pawan Kumar Srivastava, who has filed his Vakalatnama on behalf of the opposite party no.2, today in Court, which is taken on record, and Sri Rajesh Kumar, learned A.G.A.
for the State.

2. The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking quashing of the entire proceedings in Criminal Case No. 3558 of 2023 (State of U.P. vs. and Gajendra Singh and Others),
arising out of Case Crime No. 97 of 2023 u/S 498A, 420 , 406, 504 and 506 I.P.C. P.S.- Roravar,
District- Aligarh, pending in the court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.01,
Aligarh.

sentences.text: Thereafter, the allegation against the applicant no.1 is that he has obtained a sum of Rs.5,00,000/- under the Kishan Bima Yojana, of the husband, after obtaining the signature of the opposite party no.2 and has misappropriated the said amount and thrown away the opposite party no.2 from the matrimonial house and he has also withdrawn Rs. 20,000/- from the account of the opposite party no.2 and transferred Rs. 4,80,000/- in his account and when the opposite party no.2 demanded the said sum of rupees, the applicant has refused to pay back the said amount to the opposite party no.2.
Therefore, instant F.I.R. was lodged on the complaint of the opposite party no.2 dated 03.03.2023, on 06.03.2023.

Since, it was a dispute mainly with regard to the sum of Rs.
5,00,000/- , which was misappropriated by the applicant no.1, who was the brother-in-law of the opposite party no.2, after the death of her husband and now learned counsel for the applicants submits that the parties have settled their disputes amicably and the aforesaid amount of Rs.
5,00,000/- has already been paid to the opposite party no.2 by the applicant no.1.
Therefore, the opposite party no.2 do not want to prosecute the instant case against the applicants herein.

4. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that earlier also they had filed an application u/S 482 No.37950 of 2023(Gajendra Singh And 4 Others v.s State of U.P. and Another ), which was disposed of by this Court, vide order dated 12.10.2023, directing the parties to appear before the trial court for verification of the compromise between them.
In terms of the aforesaid order, vide order dated 04.11.2023, the trial court has verified the said compromise between the parties.
Therefore, learned counsel for the applicants prays for quashing of the entire proceedings against the applicants herein.
5. Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 do not dispute the factum of compromise and receipt of amount of Rs. 5,00,000/- by the opposite party no.2, in terms of the compromise.

6. Having regard to the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, learned A.G.A for State also do not dispute the factum of compromise between the parties and do not oppose the prayer for quashing of the entire proceedings, in view of the peculiar facts and circumstances of the case.

7. Having heard the submissions made by learned counsels for the parties, since, it was mainly a dispute with regard to an amount of Rs. 5,00,000/- which was obtained in the account of the opposite party no.2, under the Kishan Bima Yojana, after the death of her husband, which was wrongly misappropriated by the applicant no.1 and the parties have now settled their dispute and the said amount has already been paid to the opposite party no.2, to her satisfaction and the said compromise between the parties has already been verified by the trial court in terms of the direction issued by this Court.

8. In view thereof, no fruitful purpose will be served by keeping criminal proceedings against the applicants, in view of the settlement between the parties, therefore, instant application is allowed in terms of compromise between the parties having regard to the law laid down by the Apex Court in Gian Singh vs. State of Punjab and Another : (2012) 10 SCC 303; Prabatbhai Aahir Alias Prabatbhai Bhimsinghbhai Karmur and others vs. State of Gujarat and Another : (2017) 9 SCC 641; Narinder Singh & Ors. vs. State of Punjab : (2014) 6 SCC 466 and the entire proceedings in Criminal Case No.
3558 of 2023 (State of U.P. vs. and Gajendra Singh and Others), arising out of Case Crime No. 97 of 202 u/S 498A,420 , 406, 504 and 506 I.P.C. P.S.- Roravar, District- Aligarh, pending in the court of Gajendra Singh And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66609324/
